title: sgs: response-balanced sampling for slope-stability surrogate models (analysis code)
description: Code of the study on response-balanced sampling for slope-stability surrogate models: it generates the designs, solves them with xslope 0.5.2 (Bishop simplified), fits and tunes the surrogates, evaluates them on the two test sets, runs the replications and the structural analysis, and writes every table and figure of the study. The solved analyses are deposited separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23618253). The Git history of the repository records the order of the study's declarations and results. Release 1.1.0 adds sgs curate, which writes the curated deposit of the same analyses (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24088012), and sgs benchmark, its FOS baseline; the study's own results are unchanged. Release 1.2.0 adds further designs and checks, declared in docs/revision-declaration.md before any of their sets was drawn: arms with the target on the decision range, a decomposition of the sequential variant, a seed study, two larger test sets, a two-level bootstrap, robustness checks and a Gaussian process. Their sets are in version 1.1 of the data deposit (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24374247); every earlier set, fit and result is unchanged.
